title: Minimalist Decorative Vase
author: Daniel.stangl
description:
## 🇩🇪 **Product Description (German)**

### 🌾 Minimalist Decorative Vase – 3D Model for Home Printing

This self-designed **minimalist decorative vase** combines modern home aesthetics with a calm, natural aura. Its organic shape, gently structured surface, and clear silhouette make it an elegant accent for any home.

#### ✨ Design & Character

- Original design with a harmoniously rounded shape
- Fine texture for a high-quality, matte look
- Perfectly suited for dried flowers, grasses, or single decorative stems
- Adds calm, modern accents to living rooms, offices, or bedrooms

#### 📦 Included Files

- High-quality STL file of the vase
- Scalable for small decorative objects or larger statement vases
- Optional: Printing recommendations and size notes

#### 💡 Use Cases

- Stylish home decor
- Perfect for dried flower arrangements such as wheat, pampas grass, or bunny tails
- An aesthetic single object even without content

### 🌾 Minimalist Decorative Vase – 3D Model for Home Printing

This original **minimalist decorative vase** blends modern interior design with a calm, natural aesthetic. Its soft, organic shape and subtle surface texture create a clean, elegant look that fits seamlessly into any contemporary home.

#### ✨ Design & Character

- Unique original design with a gently rounded silhouette
- Fine surface texture for a premium matte appearance
- Perfect for dried flowers, grasses, or single decorative stems
- Adds a quiet, modern accent to living rooms, offices, or bedrooms

#### 📦 Included Files

- High‑quality STL file of the vase
- Fully scalable for small décor pieces or larger statement vases
- Optional: printing recommendations and size notes

#### 💡 Use Cases

- Stylish home décor
- Ideal for dried flower arrangements such as wheat, pampas grass, or bunny tails
- Looks elegant even without any floral insert
